def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half[r] for r in range(n)]
